scope: User-supplied distilled FP8 source/model render triplet and complete read-only comparison of both installed Q2 exports; export command provenance not established by filenames.

assessment.export_equality: All 201 ordered tensor payloads, names, types, shapes, interpreted metadata and effective alignment match. Whole-file SHA256 differs; do not call the entire files byte-identical.
assessment.runtime: Saved active GGUF model paths and user-supplied images support rendering of both Q2 files in this setup.
assessment.visual: All three supplied gothic portraits retain coherent face/hand/hair/jewelry structure without gross image collapse. Different faces, hand poses and framing are visible; differing seeds prevent attribution to quantization or backend.
assessment.drift_classification: Not controlled: seed mismatch; no causal drift or quality-parity conclusion.
assessment.next_control: Disable seed increment/randomization and render both Q2 files with one fixed seed in both sampling passes. Compare actual decoded pixels; use that same seed for the original.
limits: Exact source/build commands for the two user-provided exports have not been independently established.
One distilled checkpoint and workflow do not establish universal model/backend equivalence.
